headline: Patent pending. The first purchase orders are out, and deposits are open.

stages.title: Parts on order
stages.note: The first purchase orders went out August 20 - wheels, sprockets, shafts, and steering parts are on order from the batch suppliers. Frame fabrication is next.

stages.title: Taking deposits
stages.note: A $500 deposit holds a numbered build slot, fully refundable until you approve your final invoice. The deposit link is live on the homepage and right here on this page. If deposits ever outrun the current batch, your call: a full refund, or first in line for the next batch.

stages.title: In production
stages.note: Frames welded at a professional fabrication shop, then every cart is built by John in slot order - same hands that built the original cart. Each one gets a serial number and a recorded test before it leaves.

stages.title: Delivering
stages.note: Hand-delivered by John, Maine to New Jersey, in build-slot order.

footnote: This page is updated when something real happens, and only then.
